verdict.rationale: Drata documents the building blocks of a compliance program inside its own platform: a Policy Center, controls with requirement mappings, frameworks, an Evidence Library, audits and monitoring tests. Community threads confirm teams run SOC 2 on it, including an option to upload screenshots as evidence instead of using the agent. However, no first-party evidence explicitly names SOC 2, the Trust Services Criteria, or the Type I versus Type II workflows. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of built-in SOC 2 Trust Services controls, Type I and Type II audit workflows, prebuilt required-policy templates, auditor evidence-request handling, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end SOC 2 run.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: Create Control ... Modify Control ... List Requirements for Control
List Frameworks ... Create Custom Framework ... List Framework Requirements
Create Evidence Library Item ... Update Evidence Library Item
the agent isn't mandatory for SOC2. There is an option to upload screenshots of settings periodically instead
